title: Parsley Health clinicians section
description: A wide light serif title and a lead with an underlined sage link, then a short checklist with thin check marks and a clinician's name in small bold capitals; a cut-out portrait stands on the section's bottom edge to the right. Beige band on desktop, ivory on phones (where a rule follows the lead and the portrait tucks into the bottom-right corner). On entering view the text rises 16px and fades in, and the portrait scales up from 96% as it fades in.
notes: media is the cut-out portrait, bottom-aligned like object-fit: contain; empty, a faint placeholder stands in
the reveals are CSS view timelines; without support, or with reduced motion, all shows in place
